small_model_backend: onnx CPU; 4 intra and 1 inter threads
vlm_engine: llama-cpp; official Q8_0 model; model config concurrency=2
sample_selection: All 12 previously frozen P1 source pages, all 3 paired variants. No score-dependent exclusion.
accuracy: Same P1 text normalization, 6 prose pages eligible; include auxiliary text/header/footer; do not use Markdown formatting for CER.
complex_elements: Save raw layout, table/formula content and crops; no semantic accuracy inferred from presence.
runtime: 16 GiB unified memory, Apple Silicon arm64, 10 CPU cores; dependencies isolated in .venv-mineru.
failure_policy: Preflight failures recorded separately; no accuracy run claimed for unavailable engine. Attempt full fixed manifest only after one non-benchmark smoke succeeds. Timeout/failure inside launched accuracy run remains in denominator.
